method: Blind grading from the nine pack images only (source elevations vs model variant X / Y) against PROTOCOL.md section 3 and the reference feature lists. Positions were measured as % of wall width on crops. 'correct'/'phantoms' are counted per model side AS LABELLED against the source elevation of that side; narrow windows and doors drawn by the model are included in the counts, roof windows are not. Full-height brown slabs that coincide with source wood panels are counted as material, not openings.
usefulRule: 'useful' = PROTOCOL section 3 (1)-(5); where a non-KEY F4 sub-feature (small recess, gablet, screen) is the only F problem I say so in usefulWhy. 'usefulStrict' = additionally every F feature (F1-F4) must be OK.
couldNotJudge: aurora F1 'lower addition at the side': I cannot identify a separate lower volume in the source elevations of the pack (only a shallow wood-clad corner bay under the main eave); judged on the main body.
ballina C1: no chimneys in the source.
sakura: which source side elevation is left/right is inferred from roof silhouettes, not labelled; the (5) failure of both variants depends on it.
alberto: which gable is the right side is inferred from the stone corners (front right end / rear left end); X-vs-Y preference depends on it.
Interiors, dimensions in metres, and anything not visible in the four elevations + axonometrics.
Whether black / dark-grey blocks (jeziorko rear, mindelo entrance and rear recess) are meant as openings or material panels.
